question: Find the total surface area of ​​a cube of side 40 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total surface area of a cube is 6 times the area of one square face.

Area of one face = 40 × 40 = 1600 cm².

Total Surface Area = 6 × 1600 = 9600 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 9600 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cube

The volume of space enclosed by a cube is given by V = a³, where a is the side length.

Lateral Surface Area

The lateral surface area includes only the four side faces (excluding the top and bottom faces), calculated as LSA = 4a².

Diagonal of a Cube

The length of the main diagonal connecting two opposite corners of the cube is given by d = a√3.
